# VariFlight

> VariFlight is a leading provider of air travel services and digital technology solutions, specializing in aviation data intelligence, Total Airport Management (TAM) systems, and mobile applications. Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Hefei, China, the company serves over 300 million travelers and thousands of businesses with comprehensive aviation data covering 1,200+ airlines and 10,000+ airports globally.

VariFlight operates through three main business pillars: enterprise TAM solutions for airports, scalable data services for various industries, and consumer/professional mobile applications. The company's mission is "Living on time" - using technology to improve flight data transparency and reduce delays.

Key differentiators include the proprietary Flight Happiness Index (FHI), AI-enhanced delay predictions, comprehensive real-time aircraft tracking via global ADS-B network, and carbon emissions calculation services. With over 60% of its 300-500 employees focused on R&D, VariFlight positions itself as a technology-driven platform rather than just a data provider.

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Total Airport Management (TAM)](https://www.variflight.com/en/products/total-airport-management): Comprehensive AI-driven airport operations platform including A-CDM, GMAN, VAS, RIPAS, RMS, SURF, and TMAN modules
- [VariFlight Big Data Platform](https://www.variflight.com/en/products/VariFlight-big-data-platform): Foundation platform aggregating 20+ years of aviation data from 9,000+ airports and 800+ airlines
- [DataWorks Platform](https://dataworks.variflight.com/): Industry data solutions platform providing structured APIs and ready-to-use solutions for B2B clients
- [Flight Happiness Index](https://www.variflight.com/index.php?m=home&c=Lists&a=index&tid=13&n=8): Proprietary index evaluating flight journey quality including amenities, aircraft type, and on-time history
- [Carbon Emissions Calculator](https://www.variflight.com/en/products/carbon-emissions): ICAO/EEA methodology-based carbon footprint calculation for flights

## Data Services & APIs

- [Flight Status Data](https://www.variflight.com/en/products/flight-status): Real-time and AI-enhanced predictive flight information
- [Real-time Aircraft Tracking](https://www.variflight.com/en/products/aircraft-tracking): ADS-B based global aircraft position and trajectory data
- [Global Airline Schedules](https://www.variflight.com/en/products/airline-schedules): Comprehensive route and timetable information with dynamic updates
- [Aviation MCP Server](https://dataworks.variflight.com/mcp): Standardized interface for AI/ML teams to access structured aviation data

## Industry Applications

- [Air Travel Industry](https://www.variflight.com/en/industries/travel-tech): Solutions for OTAs, TMCs, airlines, and travel technology companies
- [Aircraft Leasing](https://www.variflight.com/en/industries/aircraft-leasing): Real-time asset tracking and risk management for lessors
- [Technology & Mobility](https://www.variflight.com/en/industries/technology): APIs for smartphone manufacturers, social platforms, and mobility services
- [Travel Management](https://www.variflight.com/en/industries/travel-management-company): Corporate travel optimization and ESG reporting tools

## Mobile Applications

- [VariFlight Consumer App](https://www.variflight.com/index.php?m=home&c=Lists&a=index&tid=7&n=8): Free travel companion app with 180M+ downloads for flight tracking and booking
- [VariFlight PRO](https://www.variflight.com/index.php?m=home&c=Lists&a=index&tid=8&n=8): Professional tool for aviation industry with advanced analytics and historical data access
